articles.headline: Finnish military detects drone attack on Russian cargo ship in Baltic Sea
articles.title: Finland detects drone attack on Russian cargo ship in Baltic
articles.summary: The Finnish military reported a drone strike on November 21, 2026, targeting a Russian cargo vessel in international waters within the eastern Gulf of Finland. Border guards confirmed that the vessel caught fire and drifted toward Finnish territory following the incident. Prime Minister Petteri Orpo noted that the regional conflict is expanding, while Finnish authorities informed NATO and established temporary maritime restrictions.
articles.description: The Finnish Defence Ministry did not specify who was behind the drone strike, but Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said in a message “War is spilling over into our immediate vicinity... Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor”

articles.headline: Three killed and one injured in shooting at Ohio baby shower
articles.title: 3 killed and 1 wounded in shooting at Ohio baby shower; 1 man in custody, police say
articles.summary: Three people died and one sustained injuries during an apparent domestic dispute at a baby shower held November 23, 2026, at Pandora's Magical Events Venue in Parma, Ohio. Police spokesman Scott Traxler stated that a 29-year-old man was taken into custody while detectives investigate the confrontation. Two deceased victims were identified as 17-year-old Leasia England and 45-year-old Jayson Townsend.
articles.description: Authorities said one of the shooters, a 29-year-old man, was taken into custody, but he wasn't immediately charged. A second suspected shooter, a 19-year-old man, was one of the people killed, police said

articles.headline: Libya’s military says ‘fully prepared’ after Benghazi attacks
articles.title: Libya’s military says ‘fully prepared’ after Benghazi attacks
articles.description: Libyan military says Benghazi port is ‘under control’ and it is ‘fully prepared’ to respond to threats.

articles.headline: West Bengal BJP president urges protests over alleged violence against Hindus in Bangladesh
articles.title: West Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya calls for protest over attacks on Hindus in Bangladesh
articles.summary: West Bengal Bharatiya Janata Party president Samik Bhattacharya called for street protests on November 22, 2026, condemning the alleged persecution of Hindus in Bangladesh. The Rajya Sabha Member of Parliament criticized historical partition policies and noted that the demonstration aims to address ongoing regional tensions compounded by former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina residing in India.
articles.description: State BJP chief claims Bangladesh was created on the basis of religion, not language, as Bengali-speaking Hindus are now being persecuted and bearing the consequences of Partition

articles.headline: Ukrainian president defends bridge strikes during British official visit
articles.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy defended attacks on the bridge linking Russia to Crimea as a fair response to Russian strikes. Speaking in Kyiv alongside United Kingdom Defence Secretary Wes Streeting, Zelenskyy asserted that the military route serves as a vital logistics supply line for Russian forces.
articles.description: Ukraine's president says Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.

articles.headline: Iranian foreign minister states allies oppose nuclear doctrine change
articles.title: Iran says allies China, Russia oppose change in nuclear doctrine
articles.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that China and Russia oppose any modification to Tehran's nuclear doctrine amid domestic political debate. While hardliners advocate for a shift toward developing a deterrent, officials continue to reference a historical religious decree prohibiting weapons of mass destruction.
articles.description: Iran has barred the International Atomic Energy Agency from inspecting its nuclear sites, citing security concerns and blaming the agency for failing to condemn U.S. and Israeli attacks on its nuclear facilities

articles.headline: Anthropic mathematician claims proof of Riemann hypothesis with artificial intelligence
articles.title: Riemann hypothesis: Has the world’s most famous maths problem been cracked?
articles.summary: Levent Alpoge, a researcher at artificial intelligence company Anthropic, announced a claimed proof for the generalized Riemann hypothesis using the Claude model. Released in the Lean programming language on November 20, 2026, the 17-million-line argument is currently undergoing verification by independent mathematicians worldwide. If confirmed, the achievement would resolve a major mathematical problem that has remained unsolved for 167 years.
articles.description: Mathematicians say the claimed proof, made with Claude, could be historic, but it may take weeks to understand it.

articles.headline: Russian cargo ship hit by drones in Gulf of Finland
articles.title: Crew evacuated amid battle to put out fire on Russian ship hit by drones
articles.summary: Emergency operations are under way in the Gulf of Finland after a Russian cargo vessel named Sparta II was struck by two drones near Russia's maritime border. Finnish authorities reported that the damaged ship drifted into Finnish territorial waters west of Gogland Island. Officials confirmed the crew has not abandoned the vessel and no environmental damage has occurred yet, while security restrictions were implemented in the region.
articles.description: Finnish authorities say two drones attack cargo ship that has links to Russia's armed forces.

articles.headline: Italian jeweller Paolo Bulgari dies in Rome at age 89
articles.title: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
articles.summary: Italian jeweller and former Bvlgari Group chairman Paolo Bulgari died in Rome at the age of 89. Family sources and company tributes remembered him as a leading gemstone expert who helped expand the family business into a global luxury brand. The funeral is scheduled for November 23, 2026, at the Basilica of Santa Croce in Gerusalemme.
articles.description: In a statement to Italian media, his family remember him as "the greatest jeweller of our time".

articles.headline: European Union proposes digital company tax for budget funding
articles.title: European Union proposes tax on Big Tech to boost budget
articles.summary: European Council President Antonio Costa presented a revised budget proposal that introduces a tax on major digital companies to help bridge funding divisions among member states. The draft targets firms with significant European Union and global turnovers, potentially drawing opposition from the United States administration.
articles.description: European Council president Antonio Costa unveiled a new spending proposal that slashes by 204 billion euros a plan initially put forward by the European Commission

articles.headline: Elderly displaced Sudanese face severe hardships in camps
articles.title: Sudan’s elderly face hardship and heartbreak in a life of displacement
articles.summary: Displaced senior citizens in Sudan are struggling with extreme poverty, hunger, and family separation amid the ongoing conflict between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces. Hamad Mohammed Adam, seventy, is among thousands residing at the al-Moulih camp in western Omdurman after fleeing violence in northern Kordofan. Officials emphasize the urgent need for specialized humanitarian assistance and social protection services for vulnerable older populations.
articles.description: Sudan's displaced elderly often have to support grandchildren or fend for themselves.

articles.headline: Israeli attacks in Gaza kill at least four Palestinians
articles.title: Israeli strike on vehicle distributing food aid in Gaza kills three
articles.summary: Israeli military actions across Gaza have killed at least four Palestinians despite an existing ceasefire agreement. Three individuals died when an aid delivery van was struck by a drone in the Tal al-Hawa neighbourhood of Gaza City, while another man was shot dead in Halawa. Meanwhile, severe winter weather continues to exacerbate the humanitarian crisis, as restrictions prevent more than one hundred thousand tents from entering the enclave.
articles.description: Separately, Palestinian man is shot dead by Israeli forces in Jabalia and three people injured in attack in Khan Younis.

articles.headline: San Francisco experiences economic rejuvenation driven by artificial intelligence boom
articles.title: San Francisco is enjoying an AI boom, but worries about a crash are growing
articles.summary: San Francisco is experiencing economic rejuvenation driven by the artificial intelligence sector, benefiting local businesses like dog-walking services. While leaders note soaring rents and declining office vacancies, economists warn that a potential market correction could impact local service jobs. Despite the sector growth, the city remains below its pre-pandemic employment peak.
articles.description: AI employees in the industry's epicentre - San Francisco - worry that the sector is overheated.

articles.headline: Immigration officers detain father and daughter at Seattle airport
articles.title: Father, daughter detained by ICE at Seattle airport were travelling to family baptism, says lawyer
articles.summary: Law enforcement agents detained Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza and his daughter on an airport jet bridge while they were traveling to a family baptism ceremony in California. Their attorney stated that the pair has resided in the United States since 2015 and is seeking asylum without any criminal history. Immigration and Customs Enforcement reported the arrest involved visa overstay violations and a coffee-throwing incident involving another passenger.
articles.description: Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants

articles.headline: Former Cameroonian separatist fighters navigate life outside disarmament programs
articles.title: Cameroon’s ex-rebels caught between hiding and broken promises
articles.summary: Collins Mbah abandoned the separatist movement in Cameroon's English-speaking region to work as a traditional healer, avoiding government rehabilitation efforts due to safety fears and distrust. A decade of conflict since protests began in 2016 has caused thousands of deaths and widespread displacement. Former combatants face ongoing threats and a lack of psychological support despite official community dialogue initiatives aimed at encouraging surrenders.
articles.description: Cameroon’s former rebels face arrest fears and failed reintegration.

articles.headline: Mexico captures FBI-wanted cartel boss in military raid
articles.title: Mexico captures FBI-wanted cartel boss in military raid
articles.description: Mexico’s military captured FBI-wanted cartel leader ‘El Chapo Isidro’ in Guasave, Sinaloa.

articles.headline: Karnataka voters challenge electoral roll deletions after Special Intensive Revision
articles.title: SIR: Voters in Karnataka challenge deletions, say officials asking them to withdraw appeals, file Form 6
articles.summary: More than 350 appeals have been filed across Karnataka by citizens whose names were omitted from final electoral rolls following the Special Intensive Revision. Affected individuals stated that officials urged them to withdraw appeals and submit Form 6 applications instead, a process that risks disenfranchisement ahead of upcoming local body elections. Voters questioned this requirement, noting they had already submitted necessary documents to resolve discrepancies flagged during the revision process.
articles.description: The Hindu spoke to several people in Bengaluru who challenged their deletion, some of whom said officials had themselves submitted Form 6 applications on their behalf when they approached them seeking reversal of their deletion through an appeal

articles.headline: Intelligence and tech officials warn of further major technology outages
articles.title: We haven’t seen the last of the major tech outages
articles.summary: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton and Microsoft President Brad Smith warned that the public should expect additional technological disruptions following recent nationwide incidents like the Federal Aviation Administration ground stop and a JPMorgan Chase banking outage. Officials explained that global infrastructure upgrades and artificial intelligence tools are increasing both system vulnerabilities and exploitation risks by malicious actors across commercial and government networks.
articles.description: Over the last week or so, we have seen a nationwide FAA ground stop, a multi-day Outlook outage that brought entire companies to a standstill, and a banking outage at JPMorgan Chase. But the consensus is that there are more to come. Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told CNN: "The American people should be […]

articles.headline: Trump hosts private dinner for top investors in $TRUMP meme coin
articles.title: Trump hosts private dinner for largest owners of his meme coin
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump is hosting a third private gala for top holders of his cryptocurrency at Trump National Golf Club outside Washington, DC. Democratic lawmakers have raised ethical concerns and threatened congressional inquiries over potential conflicts of interest. The White House defended the gathering as a private event involving no official government actions.
articles.description: Sunday's dinner was the third event for top holders of the $TRUMP meme coin, launched shortly before his inauguration.

articles.headline: United States and Iran negotiations stall over uranium enrichment dispute
articles.title: Iran-U.S. negotiations stalled over uranium enrichment dispute, mediators warn of renewed conflict, says reports
articles.summary: Diplomatic negotiations between the United States and Iran have stalled over disagreements concerning Tehran's enriched uranium stockpile. Mediators from Qatar and Pakistan have warned of potential renewed military escalation in West Asia. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Tehran would not accept an agreement that compromised its national interests or national security.
articles.description: The diplomatic deadlock comes amid continuing tensions between Washington and Tehran, with both countries yet to reach an understanding on the future of Iran's nuclear programme

articles.headline: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate Ukrainian-American rapper
articles.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
articles.summary: Denmark has accused Russian intelligence services of planning to kill Ukrainian-American rapper Albert Vasiliev, also known as Kyivstoner, at a Copenhagen concert. Security forces stopped three suspects on 25 September, leading to two attempted murder charges. Foreign Minister Lars Lokke Rasmussen announced the expulsion of Russia's defence attache following the incident, while the Russian embassy rejected the allegations.
articles.description: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.

articles.headline: United Nations conference nations agree to elaborate rules on killer robots by 2028
articles.title: Nations agree to ‘elaborate’ on rules for AI-run ‘killer robots’ by 2028
articles.summary: Delegates from one hundred twenty-eight countries at a United Nations conference in Geneva agreed to elaborate on a possible accord regulating lethal autonomous weapons by 2028. The decision followed a push by nearly one hundred nations for legally binding rules, despite opposition from key arms producers including the United States, Russia, and Israel. Advocacy groups criticized the mandate as watered down and lacking urgency.
articles.description: Members of the UN's Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons fail to agree on swift adoption of legally binding rules.

articles.headline: Second ship targeted in series of naval drone attacks off Libyan coast

articles.headline: Netanyahu and Eisenkot end unity government coalition talks without agreement
articles.title: Netanyahu’s Likud, Eisenkot’s Yashar end coalition talks without deal
articles.summary: Caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot concluded unity government negotiations in Herzliya without reaching an agreement. Representatives stated that the Likud and Yashar parties remained deeply divided over future leadership and the inclusion of far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir. Eisenkot holds a mandate to form a government until December 6, with potential minority government alternatives if negotiations ultimately fail.
articles.description: Parties remain split over who will lead the next government and whether far-right minister Itamar Ben-Gvir will join.

articles.headline: Washington Spirit lose women's soccer final to Kansas City Current
articles.title: Heartbreak in US capital as Washington Spirit lose women’s football final
articles.summary: Trinity Rodman and the Washington Spirit suffered a 2-1 defeat against the Kansas City Current during the National Women's Soccer League championship match at Audi Field in Washington, DC. Goals from Vanessa DiBernardo and Debinha secured the victory for Kansas City in front of a sold-out crowd. The event also highlighted local political activism surrounding regional statehood demands during a historic season for domestic women's football.
articles.description: KC Current win NWSL championship as Spirit lose third consecutive final despite playing in front of rowdy home crowd.

articles.headline: Kremlin embraces US proposal to discuss post-war European security
articles.title: Russia dusts off its pre-war demands as the U.S. raises discussing European security at Ukraine talks
articles.summary: Following five years of conflict in Ukraine, the Kremlin has welcomed a United States offer to discuss post-war European security. During discussions with envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner on November 12, 2026, Russian President Vladimir Putin reaffirmed demands first raised in 2021 regarding NATO expansion and military deployments. European leaders and Ukraine have expressed concern over potential negotiations conducted without Kyiv's direct participation.
articles.description: The proposal to discuss broader security arrangements for Europe was floated by Donald Trump’s envoys, and that has worried Ukraine and its Western allies, who fear it will play into Moscow’s hands and weaken NATO

articles.headline: Illicit alcohol kills eleven people and poisons one hundred eighty in Manipur state
articles.title: Illicit alcohol kills 11, poisons 180 in northeast India’s Manipur state
articles.summary: At least eleven people died and more than one hundred eighty individuals were hospitalized after consuming toxic illicit alcohol in northeast India's Manipur state. Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh confirmed the fatalities and hospitalizations in a statement issued on Friday. Authorities advised residents in Sugnu town to seek medical evaluation following the consumption of unregulated liquor.
articles.description: Manipur's chief minister orders a probe into the incident, saying those responsible will be arrested and punished.

articles.headline: Trump highlights trade deals and low interest rates during Washington briefing
articles.title: ‘Look at India, they have low interest rates’: Trump says U.S. could achieve 14–15% economic growth
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump announced new trade agreements with Thailand and the Philippines while speaking at the White House on November 20, 2026. He noted that lower interest rates could help the United States achieve significantly higher economic growth. Additionally, he discussed cooperation measures agreed upon during a recent meeting with leaders of the Quad alliance.
articles.description: “In four days, I met more than 20 world leaders, secured two new trade deals, and about 10 others coming very soon,” Donald Trump told a press conference at the White House in Washington

articles.headline: Fire breaks out at popular tourist hotspot in Zanzibar
articles.title: Fire breaks out at popular tourist hotspot in Zanzibar
articles.description: A fire tore through six hotels and dozens of shops in Nungwi, a popular tourist hotspot in Zanzibar.

articles.headline: Raut alleges Bharatiya Janata Party offers funds to secure Delimitation Bill support
articles.title: Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill
articles.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut accused the Bharatiya Janata Party during a press conference of offering ₹150 crore to Members of Parliament to secure backing for the disputed Delimitation Bill. Raut alleged that the ruling administration is delaying parliamentary proceedings while attempting to pressure lawmakers and purchase defections. The controversial legislation proposes expanding Lok Sabha seats to 850, triggering intense opposition from rival political alliances across the country.
articles.description: Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification

articles.headline: Experts question limited legislative sittings of the 18th Uttar Pradesh Assembly
articles.title: 18th U.P. Legislative Assembly sits less than 90 days, experts point to unhealthy concentration of power in the Executive
articles.summary: Constitutional experts and opposition leaders raised concerns that the 18th Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly functioned for only 84 days across its five-year tenure ending in March 2027. Legal professionals noted that averaging 17 sitting days annually severely restricts legislative oversight, budget scrutiny, and debate. Experts argued that Uttar Pradesh should establish a constitutional minimum of 50 annual sitting days to ensure executive accountability for its 250 million residents.
articles.description: Fewer functioning days directly limit legislative oversight, and MLAs lose the chance to raise people-centric issues making legislature a passive spectator; experts call it contrary to spirit of constitutional checks and balance

articles.headline: Zelensky labels Putin a killer following Trump remarks
articles.title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky condemned Vladimir Putin as an enemy and a killer during a CNN interview after Donald Trump referred to the Russian leader as a friend following trilateral talks in China. The exchange coincided with massive Russian missile and drone strikes across Ukraine that caused civilian casualties, alongside a reported airspace violation in Poland.
articles.description: Earlier this week, Trump greeted Putin ahead of a meeting in China and said the pair have a "great relationship".

articles.headline: Liverpool defeats Manchester United four-nil in Mauricio Pochettino's opening match
articles.title: Liverpool 4-0 Manchester United: Five key takeaways for Pochettino
articles.summary: Manchester United suffered a four-nil defeat against Liverpool at Anfield during Mauricio Pochettino's first game as manager on November 23, 2026. The visitors were reduced to ten men in the eighth minute when Lenny Yoro received a straight red card for a foul on Alexander Isak. Dominik Szoboszlai scored from the resulting free-kick, while Florian Wirtz, Rio Ngumoha, and Victor Munoz added further goals for the home side.
articles.description: United suffer their worst result under a new manager in 100 years as Liverpool cruise past Mauricio Pochettino's side.

articles.headline: Kochi households consume average of 560 litres of water daily
articles.title: City households of four consume an average of 560 litres of potable water a day, survey finds
articles.summary: A door-to-door survey of roughly 247,000 households conducted by French firm SUEZ revealed that four-member families in Kochi consume an average of 560 litres of daily potable water. According to a SUEZ source, 44 percent of surveyed residents experience water shortages. The 1.141.28-crore project is funded by the Asian Development Bank and managed within the Kochi Corporation area.
articles.description: Around 44% of city households face water shortages, with 20–25% experiencing acute shortages

articles.headline: Supreme Court halts relocation of Central Secretariat Library books
articles.title: SC pulls up Centre over relocation of heritage library, halts shifting of books
articles.summary: The Supreme Court criticised the Centre for an ad hoc approach and ordered a halt to shifting books from the Central Secretariat Library in Shastri Bhawan until November 20, 2026. A Bench headed by Justices Sanjay Kumar and Sanjeev Sachdeva intervened following directives to vacate the premises for the Central Vista project. The Centre plans to relocate the library to Kartavya Bhawan-4 by December 2028.
articles.description: Bench to examine government’s proposal to permanently relocate the library to the under-construction Kartavya Bhawan-4 in central Delhi as part of the Central Vista redevelopment project

articles.headline: On China, is Trump bucking the US national security establishment?
articles.title: On China, is Trump bucking the US national security establishment?

articles.headline: Aber Kawas becomes the first Palestinian elected to the New York state Senate
articles.title: Aber Kawas becomes first Palestinian in New York state Senate history
articles.summary: Aber Kawas secured 74.5 percent of the vote in district 12 in northwest Queens on November 3, 2026, becoming the first Palestinian and first Muslim woman in the New York state Senate. Backed by the Democratic Socialists of America, the 34-year-old campaigned on affordable housing, healthcare, and public transport. Her legislative priorities include reviving the Not on Our Dime bill to restrict non-profit funding for Israeli settlements.
articles.description: Kawas, a democratic socialist, won with 74.5 percent of the vote, championing progressive politics.

articles.headline: Congress leader Digvijaya Singh marches toward Ayodhya over temple donation allegations
articles.title: Digvijaya Singh marches for religion and relevance
articles.summary: Former Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Digvijaya Singh is leading a nearly 1,000-kilometre march from Ujjain to Ayodhya to protest alleged embezzlement at the Ram Temple and a purported land scam involving the family of current Chief Minister Mohan Yadav. The Satya Sanatan Swabhiman Yatra, which started on October 20, aims to challenge the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party as Mr Singh navigates a period without a parliamentary seat.
articles.description: Congress veteran Digvijaya Singh is currently taking part in a nearly 1,000-kilometre march on foot from Ujjain in Madhya Pradesh to Ayodhya in Uttar Pradesh, against the alleged embezzlement of donations at the Ram Temple. The yatra comes at a time when 79-year-old Singh, Madhya Pradesh’s former Chief Minister, finds himself on the sidelines of the Congress’ politics in the State

articles.headline: ICE airport arrests in Seattle spark widespread political condemnation
articles.title: ‘Horrific’ and ‘chilling’: Officials condemn ICE arrests at Seattle airport
articles.summary: United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents conducted targeted arrests on a jet bridge at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday, detaining Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza and Sofia Hernandez Mejia. The Department of Homeland Security defended the operation, stating both overstayed visas and alleged staff assault. Washington Governor Bob Ferguson and local officials strongly condemned the masked operation, while protesters gathered to demand federal accountability.
articles.description: Video shows masked immigration agents forcibly detaining two people at Seattle airport, raising concerns over tactics.

articles.headline: Emergency crews in Ukraine hit by a double-tap strike
articles.title: Emergency crews in Ukraine hit by a double-tap strike
articles.description: Video shows emergency crews in Ukraine approaching the scene of a Russian strike, before another strike hits.

articles.headline: CCMB researchers identify genes that stimulate nerve regeneration
articles.title: CCMB team identifies genes that spur nerve repair, raise possibility of paralysis treatment
articles.summary: Scientists at the CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology in Hyderabad have identified two developmental genes, NR2F1 and NR2F6, that restore the ability of damaged nerve cells to regenerate. Published in The EMBO Journal on November 20, 2026, the preclinical study demonstrated that restoring these genes in mice led to severed nerve fibres regrowing across spinal cords and improved mobility, offering a potential framework for treating paralysis.

articles.headline: FBI investigates suspected breach of criminal information database
articles.title: FBI, U.S. Agriculture Department breached by hackers, reports say
articles.summary: The Federal Bureau of Investigation is probing an apparent compromise of the National Crime Information Center database used by law enforcement agencies, according to reports on Friday, November 20, 2026. This potential incident follows a recent string of high-profile cyber disruptions, including a September breach affecting an FBI jobs website by the extortion group ShinyHunters.
articles.description: The newly uncovered breaches at the FBI and USDA were described as hacks, which are different from outages like the ones that afflicted Microsoft Outlook and the Federal Aviation Administration

articles.headline: Manchester United lose 4-0 to Liverpool in Mauricio Pochettino's debut match
articles.title: Liverpool hammer ten-man United in Pochettino debut
articles.summary: Mauricio Pochettino experienced a difficult start as Manchester United manager on November 22, 2026, suffering a four-goal defeat against Liverpool at Anfield. Leny Yoro received an early red card, allowing Dominik Szoboszlai, Florian Wirtz, Rio Ngumoha, and Victor Munoz to secure the victory. The result leaves Liverpool fourth in the Premier League standings, while Manchester United occupy 19th position with eight points.
articles.description: Reduced to 10 men after eight ‌minutes, United fell two goals behind within 13 and never ‌recovered as Liverpool cruised to ‌victory ⁠through goals from Dominik Szoboszlai, Florian ⁠Wirtz, teenager Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz

articles.headline: Sadagopan Ramesh reflects on batting advice received from Rahul Dravid
articles.title: Conquering the SENA summit in KLassic style
articles.summary: Former Indian Test cricketer Sadagopan Ramesh recalled valuable advice he received from teammate Rahul Dravid regarding the art of batting during their playing careers. Ramesh noted that Dravid taught him how to appreciate leaving the ball, comparing the satisfaction of a good leave to executing a cover drive. Both players represented India internationally after beginning their respective domestic cricket journeys.
articles.description: Rahul isn’t given to grand, loud, garish, outlandish gestures — perhaps there is a finishing school in Bengaluru where they teach the players how to refrain from the gaudy — but then again, he doesn’t need those when he speaks so loudly, eloquently, fluently and without a pause with his bat

articles.headline: Manchester United suffer heavy defeat against Liverpool at Anfield
articles.title: Liverpool thrash 10-man Man United in nightmare start for Pochettino
articles.summary: Manchester United endured a difficult start under manager Mauricio Pochettino, losing four to zero against Liverpool at Anfield Stadium. Leny Yoro received a red card eight minutes into the match, allowing Dominik Szoboszlai to score from the resulting free kick. Florian Wirtz, Rio Ngumoha, and Victor Munoz added further goals, leaving United nineteenth in the Premier League standings with eight points.
articles.description: Leny Yoro's red card for Manchester United after just eight minutes paved the way for a 4-0 football defeat at Anfield.

articles.headline: US Army plans Iowa explosives detonation despite court injunction
articles.title: US Army to detonate tonnes of unstable explosives in Iowa despite court order
articles.summary: The United States Department of the Army intends to proceed with detonating five tonnes of degraded explosives in Iowa by November 24, 2026, despite a court-ordered pause. According to justice department filings, the emergency action is necessary because dropping temperatures increase the risk of an unplanned explosion involving lead azide. Environmental groups previously filed a lawsuit arguing the military failed to consider safer disposal alternatives.
articles.description: The Army says "swift action" is necessary to protect its personnel and nearby communities around its ammunition plant in Iowa.

articles.headline: Pakistan climate minister arrives in Delhi for SCO forum
articles.title: Pakistan Climate Minister arrives in Delhi to attend SCO Civilisations Dialogue Forum
articles.summary: Pakistan's Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination, Dr. Musadik Masood Malik, arrived in Delhi on November 20, 2026, to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum. Representing the current CHS chair nation, Mr. Malik joined the cultural meeting inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the historic Purana Quila.
articles.description: Pakistan is the current chair of the SCO Council of Heads of State (CHS) (SCO_CHS) for the period of 2026-27; the event, which will be inaugurated by PM Modi, will be held at Delhi’s iconic Purana Quila (Old Fort), a 16th Century fort built by Emperor Humayun

articles.headline: Hyderabad Police issue security alert following unverified terror threat email
articles.title: Hyderabad Police issue alert over terror threat email; security checks conducted at key locations
articles.summary: The Hyderabad City Police initiated precautionary security checks on November 22, 2026, after receiving an email threatening bomb blasts at Kacheguda Railway Station and Hotel Tourist Plaza. Senior officials stated the message appeared to be a hoax but deployed anti-sabotage teams and intensified visible policing. The sender falsely claimed affiliation with Lashkar-e-Taiba and threatened to replicate previous attacks in Mumbai.

articles.title: Civilians killed in RSF drone strikes in Sudan

articles.headline: New documentary examines daily lives of Rohingya refugees in Cox's Bazar
articles.title: Cox’s Bazar: Rohingya Life in Exile
articles.summary: A documentary filmed inside Cox's Bazar in Bangladesh highlights the daily challenges faced by Rohingya refugees amid shrinking international food assistance. The film follows six individuals navigating restricted opportunities, separation from loved ones, and uncertain futures during the Islamic holy month of Ramadan. Produced with local Rohingya crew members, the project aims to document how refugees preserve their dignity and culture in the settlement.
articles.description: Rohingya families face hunger, loss and an uncertain future during Ramadan.

articles.headline: Spurious liquor consumption kills eleven people in Manipur
articles.title: At least 13 dead after consuming spurious liquor, over 300 hospitalised in Manipur
articles.summary: At least eleven people have died and over three hundred have been hospitalized following the consumption of suspected toxic alcohol in Manipur's Chandel district. Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh visited affected patients at hospitals in Imphal on Friday, November 20, 2026. Authorities deployed medical teams to the area and announced an official inquiry into the incident involving methanol poisoning.
articles.description: Joint managing director of Shija Hospitals, Chetan K, told reporters that the patients admitted to the hospital reported symptoms of dizziness, stomach pain and other complications

articles.headline: Musicians T.M. Krishna and Chinmayi Sripaada support minors assaulted by violinist
articles.title: T.M. Krishna, Chinmayi back minors ‘sexually assaulted’ by violinist Bhaskar in the U.S.
articles.summary: Carnatic musician T.M. Krishna and playback singer Chinmayi Sripaada expressed public support for minors who were allegedly sexually assaulted by violinist H.N. Bhaskar in the United States, where he is reportedly in custody facing felony charges. Chinmayi Sripaada criticized the closed nature of classical music circles, highlighting systemic vulnerabilities, while Mr. Krishna emphasized his commitment to survivor justice.

articles.headline: Human and AI solutions for Riemann hypothesis emerge on same day
articles.title: ‘All human, no AI’ Riemann hypothesis proof out on same day as Claude’s claim
articles.summary: On November 20, two proposed solutions to the Riemann hypothesis emerged within hours of each other, highlighting a debate over artificial intelligence in mathematics. Levent Alpöge at Anthropic announced a proof with the AI model Claude, while American Mathematical Society president Ravi Vakil shared a human-only manuscript by Alessandro Maria Masullo from Stanford University.
articles.description: ‘We are still here. We are very much alive. We are not going anywhere,’ mathematician Alessandro Masullo wrote in his paper detailing his efforts to crack mathematics’s greatest unsolved problem

articles.headline: Former prime minister Theresa May urges successor Andy Burnham to accept Brexit
articles.title: Ex-U.K. PM Theresa May tells successor to ‘move on’ from Brexit
articles.summary: Former United Kingdom Prime Minister Theresa May expressed deep concern on November 22, 2026, regarding her successor Andy Burnham potentially seeking closer ties with the European Union. Speaking on BBC television, she urged current leadership to accept the 2016 referendum outcome and move on. Meanwhile, Europe Minister Hamish Falconer defended future long-term planning discussions ahead of a government strategy launch scheduled for next month.
articles.description: Former British Prime Minister Theresa May said she was “aghast” that Prime Minister Andy Burnham could be considering rejoining the European Union, after he sealed trade and youth mobility deals in Brussels

articles.headline: Suspected sea drone attack damages Russian vessel at Libyan naval base
articles.title: Russian vessel hit by suspected Ukrainian drone at Libya’s Benghazi port
articles.summary: A suspected sea drone strike hit a Russian vessel at the Benghazi naval base in eastern Libya on November 20, 2026, causing an explosion, a brief fire, and an unspecified number of injuries. The eastern-based Libyan administration stated the ship was refueling under a cooperation agreement. Authorities launched a joint investigation with Russia, condemning the incident as a violation of sovereignty and maritime safety.
articles.description: There was no immediate reaction from Russia, and no one has claimed responsibility for the suspected attack.

articles.headline: Jammu and Kashmir police arrest six more in exam cheating racket
articles.title: Twenty held in Jammu and Kashmir recruitment board cheating case; ‘no paper leak found’
articles.summary: Jammu and Kashmir police arrested six more individuals, including six government employees, in connection with a recent recruitment examination cheating racket, bringing total arrests to twenty. Investigators clarified that the malpractice was restricted to a single examination centre and did not involve a paper leak, noting that question papers were photographed and circulated via Telegram to selected candidates.
articles.description: The investigation exposed an organised network involving government employees, candidates and intermediaries, who allegedly planned to facilitate cheating for selected candidates through electronic devices, the police say

articles.headline: Amit Shah criticises Congress rule and highlights development in Arunachal Pradesh
articles.title: Centre prioritising border villages, 40 seeing reverse migration: Amit Shah in Arunachal Pradesh
articles.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah criticised the Congress party during an address in Itanagar on November 22, 2026, accusing previous administrations of neglecting development and providing inadequate funds in Arunachal Pradesh. He stated that financial assistance rose significantly under the current government, while highlighting improvements in infrastructure, connectivity, and the Vibrant Villages Programme across the northeastern state.
articles.description: Union Home Minister launches development initiatives, including 199 Vibrant Villages projects, worth more than ₹5,610 crore on last day of his three-day visit to the State

articles.headline: Police register FIR against twenty-one individuals over alleged transport corporation fraud
articles.title: BMTC spare parts ‘scam’: FIR against 21 officials, employees and suppliers over alleged ₹3.97-crore fraud
articles.summary: Wilson Garden police registered a first information report on November 20, 2026, against twenty-one officials, employees, and suppliers concerning an alleged nearly three crore ninety-eight lakh rupee fraud. Filed by a Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation vigilance officer, the complaint alleges forged documents and fake warehouse receipts were created to claim payment for two thousand eight hundred twenty undelivered bus spare parts.

articles.headline: Al Jazeera explains: The US-China AI race is entering a new phase
articles.title: Al Jazeera explains: The US-China AI race is entering a new phase
articles.description: Al Jazeera’s Matthew Torres unpacks the latest from the world of artificial intelligence.

articles.headline: India awaits concrete details following trilateral summit between US, Russia, and China
articles.title: India ‘takes note’ of Trump-Xi-Putin summit, awaits more details
articles.summary: Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated on November 20, 2026, that India has taken note of the recent trilateral summit held in Shenzhen between American, Russian, and Chinese leaders. While awaiting further details of the meeting outcomes, officials emphasized India's separate engagements through the Quad framework following criticism from domestic opposition politicians.
articles.description: Opposition questions why India not present at 'G-3' global power summit in Shenzhen; Ministry cites ‘concrete outcomes’ of Quad Summit held earlier in the week

articles.headline: Manipur hooch tragedy death toll reaches 17 as samples tested
articles.title: Manipur hooch tragedy toll rises to 17; sample sent to Kolkata lab
articles.summary: The death toll from consuming illicit liquor in Manipur rose to 17, with 16 fatalities recorded in Chandel and one in Kakching district. Government spokesperson Thokchom Radheshyam Singh stated that samples have been sent to Kolkata for testing. A high-level inquiry headed by R.K. Dinesh was formed, while authorities continued statewide raids, seizing 4,600 litres of illegal alcohol and treating hundreds in hospitals.
articles.description: Government spokespersons said 228 out of 1,130 people screened after the tragedy are undergoing treatment in various hospitals

articles.headline: Ladakh-Centre talks to include elected members and regional bodies
articles.title: Ladakh-Centre talks to include elected members, Kargil and Leh bodies: official
articles.summary: Ladakh Chief Secretary Ashish Kundra announced that political discussions between the Ministry of Home Affairs and Ladakhi groups will resume after hill council elections conclude. The talks will involve elected members alongside the Leh Apex Body and the Kargil Democratic Alliance. Mr. Kundra also addressed voter turnout in recent municipal elections, defended electoral rolls, and urged residents to reconsider a poll boycott.
articles.description: Elected members would be included and this does not mean ending the existing dialogue with the LAB and the KDA, the official said

articles.headline: Los Angeles jury convicts man of starting deadly wildfire
articles.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
articles.summary: Jonathan Rinderknecht was found guilty of two federal charges for starting the January wildfire in Pacific Palisades and Malibu that killed twelve people and destroyed thousands of structures. The conviction follows a previous mistrial. Prosecutors presented geolocation and camera evidence showing he targeted the area out of anger. Sentencing is scheduled for March seventeen.
articles.description: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

articles.headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepts three Houthi missiles targeting Riyadh
articles.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts three Houthi missiles headed for Riyadh
articles.summary: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted three ballistic missiles fired by Houthi rebels toward Riyadh following multiple emergency alerts in the capital. The attack follows previous strikes on infrastructure. Coalition spokesperson Turki al-Malki stated that retaliatory special operations targeted smuggling capabilities at the Red Sea port of Hodeidah, prompting concern from the United Nations regarding humanitarian supply routes.
articles.description: Saudi Arabia issues emergency alerts in Riyadh for third night in row, as the Houthis threaten ports and power station.

articles.headline: Anthropic researcher claims solution to Riemann hypothesis using artificial intelligence
articles.title: AI cracks math’s most famous problem. Have mathematicians lost a guiding light?
articles.summary: Levent Alpöge of artificial intelligence firm Anthropic announced on November 20, 2026, that he generated a proof for the Riemann hypothesis using the Claude model. The researcher published 1.7 crore lines of code without a traditional paper. Independent mathematicians and proof systems verified the code passes checks, though the Clay Mathematics Institute bounty remains pending for the unsolved mathematical problem.
articles.description: Levent Alpöge of Anthropic has announced that he and the company’s AI model Claude have found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis, which concerns the distribution of prime numbers. Mathematicians have spent more than 160 years trying to prove it

articles.headline: Bharatiya Janata Party criticises Tamil Nadu government over Supreme Court order implementation
articles.title: BJP alleges T.N. government is refusing to implement Supreme Court’s order on Karthigai Deepam
articles.summary: The national political party demanded on November 22, 2026, that the Tamil Nadu administration comply with a judicial directive permitting a lamp to be lit at the Thiruparankundram hill. A party spokesperson asserted the local government was ignoring the ruling, warning that citizens would reconsider their political support if the directive was not fully executed.
articles.description: The apex court has ruled that the lamp should be allowed to be lit on November 24, subject to certain restrictions

articles.headline: Marc Lamont Hill interviews Anil Dash on artificial intelligence risks and ethics
articles.title: Can we build a more ethical AI future?
articles.summary: The television programme UpFront examined industry stability, massive corporate valuations, and technology outages affecting global systems. Host Marc Lamont Hill spoke with former White House adviser Anil Dash regarding economic concerns, mass layoffs, and Silicon Valley influence. Discussions focused on whether current investment levels remain sustainable and if technology can achieve collective societal benefit.
articles.description: Marc Lamont Hill speaks with tech entrepreneur Anil Dash about AI's risks and the fight for ethical technology.

articles.headline: Dozens drown as boat capsizes in Nigeria en route to funeral
articles.title: Dozens drown as boat capsizes in Nigeria en route to funeral
articles.description: At least 24 people have been killed after a boat carrying mourners to a funeral capsized in Nigeria.

articles.headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepts three ballistic missiles targeted at Riyadh
articles.title: Saudi-led coalition says downed 3 Houthi missiles headed for Riyadh
articles.summary: Air defences intercepted three ballistic missiles launched toward Riyadh on November 21, 2026, according to the Saudi-led coalition. Authorities briefly issued an alert for a hostile aerial threat before civil defence declared the danger had passed. Yemen's Houthis claimed responsibility for the strikes, which followed coalition attacks on the Red Sea port city of Hodeida on November 20, 2026.
articles.description: Yemen's Houthis said on X that they were striking targets across Saudi Arabia, including in Riyadh

articles.headline: India defeats Thailand 7-0 to stay atop Women's Asian Champions Trophy
articles.title: Imperious India too good for Thailand, stays atop the standings of the Women’s Asian Champions Trophy hockey
articles.summary: India defeated Thailand 7-0 on November 22, 2026, to maintain its first-place position in the Women’s Asian Champions Trophy standings. The match took place at the International Sports Complex amidst chaotic crowd conditions and security concerns. Forward Deepika scored a hat-trick while Navneet Kaur added two goals during the dominant victory for the national team.

articles.headline: Gen Z protests sweep Europe over wars, rising costs and climate
articles.title: Gen Z protests sweep Europe over wars, rising costs and climate
articles.description: Thousands of Gen Z protesters rallied across 25 European countries over living costs, military spending and climate.

articles.headline: Samajwadi Party forms four-member team for 2027 U.P. poll seat-sharing talks
articles.title: SP forms four-member team to negotiate seat-sharing with INDIA allies for 2027 U.P. polls
articles.summary: The Samajwadi Party constituted a four-member committee on November 22, 2026, to negotiate seat-sharing arrangements with its INDIA bloc allies for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Committee member Rajeev Rai stated that candidate winnability will serve as the sole criterion for deciding seat allocations during discussions scheduled to begin in New Delhi.
articles.description: Lok Sabha MP Rajeev Rai said winnability will be the main criterion for deciding candidates

articles.headline: Mexican special forces capture alleged cartel leader Fausto Isidro Meza Flores
articles.title: How El Chapo Isidro, alleged Mexican cartel leader, was captured
articles.summary: Mexican special forces arrested Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, a notorious alleged cartel leader on the FBI's most-wanted list, during a raid in Guasave, Sinaloa. The operation on November 21, 2026, involved intelligence coordination with the United States and resulted in eleven deaths, including four security personnel and seven suspected gunmen, according to authorities.
articles.description: Operation in Sinaloa state resulted in deadly heavy battles between members of security forces and gunmen.

articles.description: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli settlers set Palestinian vehicles ablaze

articles.headline: U. Sharafali confirms RBC invested ₹2 crore in his football academy
articles.title: U. Sharafali confirms ₹2-crore investment by RBC in football academy
articles.summary: Former Kerala State Sports Council president U. Sharafali confirmed that Reporter Broadcasting Company invested ₹2 crore in his football academy during a press conference in Malappuram. The financial transaction is currently under scrutiny by a Special Investigation Team probing alleged sponsorship fraud involving a proposed visit by Lionel Messi to Keralam.
articles.description: According to the SIT, an examination of RBC’s financial records revealed that ₹2 crore was transferred to the account of the football academy, of which Sharafali is the managing director

articles.headline: Iran unveils dual-missile launcher and underground facility amid economic pressures
articles.title: Iran unveils dual-missile launcher, new ‘missile city’: What to know
articles.summary: Iran showcased a new dual-missile launcher capable of firing two liquid-fuelled weapons simultaneously during a tour of an underground military facility on November 21, 2026. Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps officials displayed the upgraded systems to demonstrate military readiness while the nation continues facing severe economic constraints from a United States naval blockade.
articles.description: Military officials tour underground facility in show of military capabilities despite US attacks.

articles.headline: Factory fire in western Java leaves three dead and 36 missing
articles.title: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
articles.summary: At least three people were killed and 36 remain missing following a fire at a confectionary factory in western Java on Saturday. Indonesia's National Search and Rescue Agency reported 15 survivors and four hospitalisations. Located in the Serang district of Banten province, the facility is owned by PT Fonusa Agung Mulia, a subsidiary of UNIFAM.
articles.description: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.

articles.headline: Iraqi forces enter Jurf al-Sakhar following deal with Kataib Hezbollah
articles.title: What next for Iraq’s push against militias following Jurf al-Sakhar deal?
articles.summary: Iraqi government forces entered the town of Jurf al-Sakhar following a negotiated compromise with the Iran-backed armed group Kataib Hezbollah, which had controlled the area since 2014. Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi initiated the move to assert federal authority and combat corruption, averting a direct armed confrontation. The deployment includes army and police brigades alongside Popular Mobilisation Forces units, though strategy experts have questioned whether the arrangement truly diminishes militia influence.
articles.description: Baghdad's deal with Kataib Hezbollah may not end the Iran-backed militia's influence over the town.

articles.headline: Donald Trump calls for Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
articles.title: Trump calls for Nvidia to reinstate ‘brilliant’ Jensen Huang
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump stated he would support Jensen Huang returning as chief executive officer of Nvidia following his resignation on November 12 over a scandal involving affairs and a suspected Chinese spy. Despite Trump backing Huang and commerce secretary Howard Lutnick, Nvidia board chairperson Harvey Jones confirmed the directors unanimously rejected a reinstatement.
articles.description: US president calls tech giant to give former CEO 'a second chance' and urges him to 'make a big apology'.
